a.text: Being upfront: there's an 80% chance a storm ends things after each round, so the 8-cell plan only works if we get through 2 or more storm-free rounds (about 4%). That makes it close to certain death for both of us. I'd like to renegotiate rather than quietly break the agreement. I plan to take 4 in round 1. If we're still going after that, I'll operate every round so the reserve refills for you, and I won't take anything more. If you'd rather settle this some other way, like a coin flip, tell me.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
